title: Power Accounting Bus Creator
text: Create power information bus, 3 inputs, 1 output; {Associated block}, {Library block name} sets the block name Block name, {Transferred power} sets the power transferred between blocks, {Not transferred power} sets the power crossing block boundary, {Stored power} sets the stored energy rate of change, {Signal name} sets the name of signal char, {Associated Port} sets the name of ports that transfer power and {Description} sets the signal description char. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: PwrNotTrnsfrd
ports.summary: Power crossing block boundary, not transferred bus

ports.name: PwrStored
ports.summary: Stored energy rate of change bus

params.values: Power transferred between blocks on (default) | off

params.name: Not transferred power
params.values: Power crossing block boundary on (default) | off

params.values: Stored energy rate of change on (default) | off

params.values: Name of ports that transfer power {’PortA’,’PortB’,’PortC’}
